title: The Offseason Is Over. Act Accordingly.
summary: Draft season is here. A look at what's new on the site this year, and a few storylines worth keeping an eye on before Week 1.
content:
Alright, FUNTASY TOOTBALL. Enough scrolling through mock drafts at 1am — the real thing is almost here. Rosters are about to get built, rivalries are about to get renewed, and somebody in this league is about to make a draft-day decision they'll be defending in the group chat until Thanksgiving. Let's get into it.

WHAT'S NEW ON THE SITE THIS YEAR

If you haven't poked around funtasytootball.github.io lately, this is your warning: the receipts are better than ever. A few additions worth knowing about before you're on the clock —

VBD (Value Based Drafting) is now baked into everything. Instead of just raw points, every pick gets measured against what a replacement-level player at that position would've given you — computed fresh from this league's own history, adjusted automatically for our scoring and roster settings. Translation: "I got a great QB in the 4th" now has an actual number attached to it, and that number is either going to back you up or expose you.

Draft Pick Grades. Every pick, every season, graded on a real curve built from this league's own draft history — from A+ down to a very findable F. history doesn't forget, and now neither does the site.

Injury Luck. A full accounting of who got hit hardest by the injury bug each season — ranked, per team, with the receipts to match. If your season gets derailed by bad luck instead of bad drafting, at least now there's a number that says so.

All of it lives on the Season pages once games start counting, and the Records and Teams pages are always open for anyone who wants to go digging through the archives before their draft.

STORYLINES WORTH WATCHING

Who's actually got the sharpest eye on waivers this year, and who's going to be the manager everyone else is quietly thanking for leaving a league-winner on the wire? 

Somebody's going to reach two rounds early for their QB1 and either look like a genius by Week 10 or become a cautionary tale. Could be yulovesyou. Could be hmart92. Could be tduchow. The board doesn't care about your feelings.

artmane, mayshisha, JoeSifBoreDough, evangonnerman, paty23 — new draft slot, clean slate, same league that remembers everything. And YuWillLose... look, the username picked the storyline. All that's left is whether this is finally the year it ages poorly.

And somewhere in this draft, a player nobody's talking about in round 12 is going to end up being the best value pick of the whole season. The Draft Grade curve will know. It always does.

Get your rankings ready, get your sleepers picked, and get ready to find out who actually did their homework this offseason. See you on the clock.

title: Welcome To The Weekly Snap
summary: This is a starter newsletter so you can see the format — replace or delete it once real recaps start rolling in.
content:
This is where your league's weekly (or whenever-you-feel-like-it) recap will live.

To add a new issue: come back and tell me what happened this week — closest game, biggest blowout, best/worst waiver pickup, trash talk worth immortalizing — and I'll draft the write-up. Once you're happy with it, add a new object to the TOP of this array in data/newsletters.json with the same shape as this one (unique slug, issue label, title, date, a one-line summary for the list preview, and the full content), then push it to GitHub.

Each issue gets its own page automatically — nothing else to wire up.
